scientific_question: Does a caption-mediated WMA adapter preserve StructMem event extraction, cross-event consolidation, persistent detail and summary stores, and official Qdrant scoring without losing assistant-side evidence?
decision_informed: Whether StructMem can proceed to exact execution-source, dependency, model, and lifecycle gates.
scientific_evidence_role: static adapter design and mock-boundary evidence only; no real upstream import, model load, lifecycle, numerical, superiority, or SOTA claim

official_api_mapping.reset: Create fresh per-generation on-disk Qdrant detail and summary stores and reset GLOBAL_TOPIC_IDX and GLOBAL_LAST_SUMMARY_TIME.
official_api_mapping.ingest_turn: Buffer every WMA utterance and retain attachment type caption and image_id as text provenance.
official_api_mapping.end_session: Wrap each source utterance as a user message plus empty assistant placeholder exactly as the official LoCoMo builder does under messages_use=user_only. Use factual and relational event prompts, force only the final utterance, and complete process_all cross-event summaries before returning.
official_api_mapping.snapshot_memories: Exhaust official Qdrant scroll pagination for both detail and summary stores and expose stable typed ids and payload provenance.
official_api_mapping.retrieve: Embed once through the common 384-dimensional endpoint, retrieve detail and summary candidates through official Qdrant scores, sort by finite cosine score, and return no more than the single WMA top_k budget with at most five summary candidates.
official_api_mapping.reload_from_disk: Close Qdrant clients, recreate LightMemory on the same per-generation paths, reload the adapter session-id map, and require stable snapshots.
official_api_mapping.export_memory_delta: Diff typed detail and summary backend ids against the previous full snapshot.
official_api_mapping.answer: Never use upstream answer or judge scripts; pass normalized retrieval items to the common WMA answer and judge path.

model_and_backbone_contract.event_extraction_and_summary_llm: shared frozen Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct endpoint; disclosed matched-backbone substitution
model_and_backbone_contract.embedding: shared frozen Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B endpoint at 384 dimensions; disclosed common-track substitution
model_and_backbone_contract.precompressor: microsoft/llmlingua-2-bert-base-multilingual-cased-meetingbank at 5f0c82792b7ea14c6484e015b6a072009496b7f2; exact file manifest remains a mandatory later gate

license_boundary.policy: Keep the inconsistency disclosed, preserve the root LICENSE with execution source, and import the external checkout without copying implementation code into the project overlay.

static_acceptance: Both original user and assistant utterances become independent source records rather than dropping assistant evidence.
Attachment caption and image_id survive text rendering.
Only the final utterance forces segmentation and extraction.
Session completion performs the frozen summary call before returning.
Missing equal and out-of-order timestamps become strictly monotonic.
Detail and summary hits share one top_k budget.
Sample reset clears both upstream module globals.
authorization_gate: This design is not executable. Real import or lifecycle execution requires an accepted minimal execution-source copy, exact dependency wheelhouse and offline isolated environment, accepted LLMLingua model snapshot, accepted shared endpoint identities, and a separate fresh-root lifecycle-execution prefreeze.
next_gate: Freeze and materialize only the required tracked StructMem runtime files, then separately freeze dependency resolution and the LLMLingua model manifest.
prohibited_actions: installing dependencies, importing the real upstream package, loading LLMLingua, or opening Qdrant from this design
combining top_k detail hits with five extra unbudgeted summary hits
crediting caption mediation as native multimodal memory
using source-reported values in local-result cells
populating a numerical comparison-table cell or making a superiority or SOTA claim
